definitions.explanation: Demand for goods and services from outside the country — essentially exports. An economic term contrasted with domestic demand.

examples.japanese: {外需|がいじゅ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びている→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧。
⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{外需|がいじゅ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{依存|いぞん}している→依存する：20026_izonsuru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese economy depends heavily on foreign demand.

examples.japanese: {外需|がいじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{減少|げんしょう}→減少：02719_genshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{補|おぎな}う→補う：00329_oginau⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{内需|ないじゅ}→内需：15797_naiju⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧⟦{策|さく}→策：09997_saku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}ち{出|だ}した→打ち出す：06790_uchidasu⟧。
examples.english: To compensate for the decline in foreign demand, the government introduced measures to expand domestic demand.

notes:
USAGE:
An economics term frequently seen in news and business reporting. Contrasted with ⟦{内需|ないじゅ}→内需：15797_naiju⟧ (domestic demand). In economic analysis, {外需|がいじゅ} primarily refers to the net exports component of GDP.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {外需|がいじゅ}⟦{依存|いぞん}→依存：11441_izon⟧: dependence on external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}⟦{主導|しゅどう}→主導：11406_shudou⟧: led by external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧: expansion of external demand
- {外需|がいじゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{内需|ないじゅ}→内需：15797_naiju⟧: external and domestic demand
